name: Table
element: table, thead, tbody, tr, th, td, div
summary: Rows of records in columns. It is a real table, so the column names travel with the cells and a screen reader can read a row across.
summaryZh: 一行行记录分成几列。它是真表格,所以列名跟着单元格走,读屏可以横着读一行。

variants.name: Striped
variants.note: Every other row takes the lighter fill, so a long list can be counted down without reading it.

variants.name: Bordered
variants.note: A vertical line between the columns as well as the horizontal ones.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The rows are shorter and the text is smaller.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size needs no modifier class.

states.name: No header
states.note: The row of column names is not drawn.

states.name: No summary
states.note: The summary row at the foot of the table is not drawn.

states.name: Highlight current row
states.note: The table is told to mark the row the reader is on.

states.name: Current row
states.note: The row the reader is on. It takes the highlight fill when the table highlights the current row.

states.name: Append row
states.note: The row under the last record.

states.name: Aligned to the centre
states.note: The cells stand in the middle of their column rather than at its start.

states.name: Aligned to the end
states.note: The cells stand at the end of their column rather than at its start.

states.name: Fit
states.note: The columns share the width of the frame rather than taking the width their contents ask for.

states.name: Index column
states.note: The first cell of a row holds the row's number, so it stands at the end of the column and takes the muted colour.

states.name: Selection column
states.note: The first cell of a row holds the tick, so it stands in the middle of the column.

states.name: Expand column
states.note: The first cell of a row holds the marker that opens the record, so it stands in the middle of the column.

states.name: Scrollbar always on
states.note: The frame keeps its scrollbar whether the table needs one or not, so the rows do not move sideways as the table grows.

states.name: Expanded row
states.note: The record is open, so the area under it is drawn.

states.name: Expand all
states.note: Every record's expanded area is drawn, whether the record is marked as open or not.

parts.name: Wrapper
parts.note: The box around the table. It scrolls sideways on a narrow screen and carries the frame.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The thead. It is the row of column names.

parts.name: Body
parts.note: The tbody. It holds the records.

parts.name: Row
parts.note: One record. The stripe and the hover colour are painted on it.

parts.name: Cell
parts.note: One value. In the header it is a th, in the body a td.

parts.name: Empty
parts.note: The cell that says there is nothing. It spans the whole row.

parts.name: Summary
parts.note: The foot of the table. It holds the totals, not the records.

parts.name: Expanded area
parts.note: The row under a record that holds what the record opens up to. It is not drawn until the record above it is marked as open, or until the table is told to open them all.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which extra treatment the table carries. The two modifiers are independent and may be used together.
props.descriptionZh: 表格带哪一种额外处理。这两个修饰类是独立的,可以一起用。

props.name: emptyText
props.description: What the empty cell says when there are no records.
props.descriptionZh: 没有记录时,空状态那一格写什么。

props.name: stripe
props.description: Whether every other row takes the lighter fill. It adds um-table--striped, the same class the variant prop adds.
props.descriptionZh: 是否隔行加底色。它加上 um-table--striped,和 variant 属性加的是同一个类。

props.name: border
props.description: Whether a vertical line stands between the columns as well as the horizontal ones. It adds um-table--bordered, the same class the variant prop adds.
props.descriptionZh: 列与列之间是否也画一道竖线。它加上 um-table--bordered,和 variant 属性加的是同一个类。

props.name: size
props.description: How much room a row takes. The middle size needs no modifier class.
props.descriptionZh: 一行有多高。中间那一档不用加修饰类。

props.name: show-header
props.description: Whether the row of column names is drawn. Turning it off adds um-table--no-header.
props.descriptionZh: 列名那一行是否画出来。关掉它就加上 um-table--no-header。

props.name: highlight-current-row
props.description: Whether the row the reader is on takes the highlight fill. That row is marked with um-table__row--current.
props.descriptionZh: 读者所在的那一行是否带上高亮底色。那一行自己用 um-table__row--current 标记。

props.name: show-summary
props.description: Whether the summary row at the foot of the table is drawn. Turning it off adds um-table--no-summary.
props.descriptionZh: 表格底部那一行汇总是否画出来。关掉它就加上 um-table--no-summary。

props.name: align
props.description: Where the cells stand in their column. The start is the base class on its own; the centre adds um-table--align-center and the end adds um-table--align-end.
props.descriptionZh: 单元格在自己那一列里站在哪儿。靠前是只写基础类;居中加上 um-table--align-center,靠后加上 um-table--align-end。

props.name: fit
props.description: Whether the columns share the width of the frame rather than taking the width their contents ask for. It adds um-table--fit.
props.descriptionZh: 各列是否平分外框的宽度,而不是各自按内容撑开。它加上 um-table--fit。

props.name: type
props.description: The extra column the table carries: the tick, the row's number, or the marker that opens a record. The cell is the host's own, and the class says how that column is painted.
props.descriptionZh: 表格带的那一列:勾选框、行号,或者展开记录的记号。那一格是宿主自己写的,这个类说明那一列怎么画。

props.name: default-expand-all
props.description: Whether every record's expanded area is drawn, whether the record is marked as open or not. It adds um-table--default-expand-all.
props.descriptionZh: 每条记录的展开区域是否都画出来,不管那条记录有没有被标成展开。它加上 um-table--default-expand-all。

props.name: scrollbar-always-on
props.description: Whether the frame keeps its scrollbar whether the table needs one or not, so the rows do not move sideways as the table grows. It adds um-table--scrollbar-always-on.
props.descriptionZh: 外框是否一直留着滚动条,不管表格用不用得上,这样表格变宽时行不会横向挪动。它加上 um-table--scrollbar-always-on。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The rows of the table. Each one is a row of cells.
slots.descriptionZh: 表格里的行。每一行是一排单元格。

slots.name: header
slots.description: The row of column names. Each one is a heading cell with scope="col".
slots.descriptionZh: 列名那一行。每一个都是带 scope="col" 的表头单元格。

slots.name: empty
slots.description: What the empty cell says when there are no records. Without it the emptyText prop says it.
slots.descriptionZh: 没有记录时,空状态那一格写什么。不给就用 emptyText 属性里的文字。

slots.name: append
slots.description: What stands under the last record: a loading row, a load-more button.
slots.descriptionZh: 最后一条记录下面放什么:一行加载中,或者一个加载更多的按钮。

slots.name: summary
slots.description: What the summary row at the foot of the table says: the totals.
slots.descriptionZh: 表格底部那一行汇总写什么:合计。

slots.name: expand
slots.description: What a record opens up to. It is given the number of the record. The area under a record is not drawn until the record is marked as open, or until the table is told to open them all.
slots.descriptionZh: 一条记录展开后露出什么。它拿到这条记录的序号。记录下面的展开区域要等这条记录被标成展开、或者表格被要求全部展开时才画出来。

a11y.notes: A real table with a thead and a tbody, so the column names are announced with every cell and the reader can move across a row. Put scope="col" on the header cells. The wrapper scrolls sideways when the columns are too many to squeeze; a scrollable region has to be reachable by keyboard, so give the wrapper tabindex="0" and a name.
a11y.notesZh: 这是带 thead 和 tbody 的真表格,所以列名会跟着每个单元格一起播报,读者也能横着读一行。表头单元格要写上 scope="col"。列太多挤不下时外框会横向滚动,而可滚动区域必须能用键盘够到,所以要给外框加 tabindex="0" 和一个名字。

examples.title: A table
examples.description: The header row takes the light fill and the lines under the rows take the lighter border. The frame belongs to the wrapper, so the outer edge is one line all the way round.
examples.descriptionZh: 表头那行用浅底色,行与行之间的线用更浅的描边色。外框由 wrapper 负责,所以最外一圈始终是一条线。

examples.title: Striped and bordered
examples.description: The striped variant paints every other row; the bordered variant adds the line between the columns. The hovered row takes the fill one step stronger than the stripe, so the pointer still says which row it is on.
examples.descriptionZh: 斑马纹变体给隔行上色,带竖线变体在列与列之间加一道线。鼠标所在的那一行用的是比斑马纹深一档的底色,所以指针指到哪一行还是看得出来的。

examples.title: No rows
examples.description: The empty cell spans the row. It says the fact and leaves the reason to the page that owns the data.
examples.descriptionZh: 空状态那一格横跨整行。它只说事实,原因留给拥有这份数据的页面去写。

notes: The frame belongs to the wrapper and the lines to the cells, so the outside edge is one line everywhere and the inner lines meet it instead of doubling it. The stripe and the header fill are two different fills on purpose: the stripe has to stay behind the text without pulling the eye off it.
notesZh: 外框归 wrapper,线条归单元格,于是最外一圈始终是一条线,里面的线也是接上去而不是叠成两条。斑马纹和表头用的是两种不同的底色:斑马纹要留在文字后面,又不能把视线从文字上拽走。
